# Arrow AI

> Arrow AI builds enterprise AI solutions. Its AI Prospecting product is an AI search engine for B2B sales: you describe your ideal customer in plain language, AI agents search the live web, find matching companies and decision-makers, explain why each one matches with sources, verify their contact details and export them to your CRM.

Languages: English, French, Spanish.

## AI Prospecting
- [AI Prospecting (EN)](/en/prospecting): overview, how it works in 3 steps, features, use cases, comparison with static lead databases, pricing, FAQ.
- [Prospection IA (FR)](/fr/prospecting): version française.
- [Prospección IA (ES)](/es/prospecting): versión en español.

## Key facts
- Search method: natural-language description of an ideal customer profile (ICP), no fixed filters.
- Data: read from public web sources at query time (websites, job posts, news, registries), plus contact enrichment and real-time email verification.
- Each lead includes evidence and source links explaining why it matches.
- Integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Lemlist, CSV, API.
- Compliance: GDPR, EU data hosting, DPA available.
- Plans: Starter (free, 50 leads), Growth (€99/month, 1,000 leads), Enterprise (custom).
